results.rationale: Forward system feature obligation is broadly credible from our web/mobile banking solution experience, but the evidence does not explicitly confirm browser-based delivery and RBAC support.
Providing a DR site is credible given multiple cloud infrastructure deployments, but no record explicitly demonstrates an RTO of ≤4 hours.
Bilingual (English/Urdu) UI delivery is plausible from LMS development experience, but the summaries do not explicitly state Urdu interface capability.
On-site support for 12 months with an SLA is a forward delivery commitment and is credible based on our documented in-country support model and relevant infrastructure/IT delivery experience.
Compliance with Provincial Data Protection Guidelines 2024 is a forward legal compliance obligation and is credibly supported by our ISO 27001 certification and prior work in sensitive domains.
Procedural commitment — complied with in the submission (affidavit can be provided as required).
The company profile does not evidence at least two CISSP (or equivalent) certified data security professionals, so the named staffing credential requirement is not met.
